limitations: The training records are commit-level while runtime predictions aggregate a whole pull request.
Training projects and languages may differ from repositories analysed by Adept.
The score ranks estimated review risk and does not prove that a defect exists.
The prepared dataset FIX field is used for training; runtime keyword matching is an MVP approximation.
The prepared change metrics exclude some non-source files; the later runtime extractor must make and document a file-scope decision before claiming training/runtime parity.
